description: Cockpit panel registry. Each panel declares id, name, sizes, feature, and trust tier.

stability_tiers.0: Experimental — built and used by author, no external validation
stability_tiers.1: Tested — used by at least one non-author operator without modification
stability_tiers.2: Stable — tested across multiple neurological profiles

panels.name: Task Surface
panels.description: Current task queue — one at a time surfacing

identity.interest: I want to know what I should be doing right now without holding it in my head
identity.roadblock: Multiple simultaneous demands create paralysis — can't prioritize from a list
identity.accommodation: Shows one task at a time, context-filtered. The system holds the queue.

panels.name: Time Factory
panels.description: Balloon timeline calendar — visual time perception

identity.interest: I need to feel how my day is shaped without constantly checking a clock
identity.roadblock: Time blindness — can't sense the passage of hours, appointments feel abstract
identity.accommodation: Balloon positions encode time of day visually; urgency pulsing encodes deadline pressure. Makes time spatial and legible.

panels.name: Vault
panels.description: File tree browser for the vault

identity.interest: I want to browse and find things in my second brain
identity.roadblock: Standard file trees don't show note metadata; can't find what I need by context
identity.accommodation: Vault-aware file tree with frontmatter preview, tags, and search. Metadata visible at a glance.

panels.name: Assistant
panels.description: AI chat — capture, enrich, ask questions

identity.interest: I want to think out loud and have someone hold the thread
identity.roadblock: Working memory can't hold complex reasoning chains; trains of thought derail mid-sentence
identity.accommodation: Chat keeps full context. Externalizes reasoning — the conversation is the thinking.

panels.name: Ink Blotter
panels.description: Sketch, notes, docs, diagrams — creative capture

identity.interest: I need a low-friction space to dump ideas in any format
identity.roadblock: Choosing the right tool for a thought is a separate executive decision — kills the thought
identity.accommodation: Sketch, notes, docs, diagrams in one panel. Save to vault with one click. Format follows intent.

panels.name: Terminal
panels.description: System terminal — Claude, git, file ops

identity.interest: I need a shell embedded in my prosthetic environment
identity.roadblock: Context-switching to a separate terminal app breaks flow, loses the thread
identity.accommodation: Full terminal panel inside the cockpit. No alt-tab, no context break.

identity.interest: I want to change my state or trigger an action without navigating menus
identity.roadblock: Executive function tax accumulates per decision — menu navigation is a wall, not a step
identity.accommodation: One-tap mode switch, context display, common actions. Zero navigation, instant state change.

panels.name: Projects
panels.description: Project dashboard — status, progress, next steps

identity.interest: I need to see the state of everything I'm working on without opening each file
identity.roadblock: Object impermanence for projects — if I can't see it, it stops existing in my attention
identity.accommodation: Live dashboard of all projects with status, word counts, last session. Makes invisible work visible.

panels.name: Sprint Timer
panels.description: Pomodoro-style writing sprint with post-session log

identity.interest: I want to write in focused bursts without burning out
identity.roadblock: Hyperfocus or nothing — no middle gear. Either write for 4 hours or can't start.
identity.accommodation: Timed sprints (25min default) with post-session log. Bounds the session, captures where you stopped, sets tomorrow's entry point.
